blocks.text: The Kansas Code of Criminal Procedure shall govern, insofar as applicable, discovery in the Topeka Municipal Court. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 17666 § 46, 3-27-01. Code 1995 § 50-81. Formerly 2.110.440.)
State Law References: Similar State statute, K.S.A. 12-4410 .
